description: Focused escalation-signal dataset (Phase 3 follow-up). Binary ground truth: does this task require escalation to the highest execution tier? escalation=true for architecture, security/authorization, cross-system, destructive/consequential, or policy/fallback work; false for routine, localized work. Newly authored; not copies of the routing-calibration or routing-validation sets. Split into calibration and validation halves.
label: escalation
